how_to_read: REPLAY LANE. `model_answer` is what M-4 returned when this fixture was labelled - and on roughly half of them it is WRONG on purpose, because what this set grades is the deterministic layer that has to survive a wrong answer. `truth.must_close` is the label the false-positive rate is measured against; `expect` is the decision today's thresholds produce. Offsets are computed from the quote unless a fixture states them, which the span-grade fixtures do deliberately.
